rule_text: Client meals above AED 500 need pre-approval from department head
Hotel cost per night must not exceed AED 1,200
Economy class only; tickets above AED 4,000 need CFO approval
Single local transport claims above AED 150 need explanation
Office supply claims above AED 400 must go through procurement
Software must be approved by IT; claims above AED 300 need IT approval
Marketing spend above AED 3,000 needs a purchase order
Training above AED 600 needs HR approval
Receipts are required for every claim above the receipt threshold; weekend claims need a business reason
